title: Make quality gates proportional to the changed surface
outcome: Use a small explicit validation policy so prose-only edits do not rerun unrelated Rust and host suites, while runtime and storage changes retain appropriate coverage.
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are identical, and skill/review-command guidance is consistent; examples distinguish Markdown code blocks or quoted commands from executable files, and focused correction checks never substitute for required landing validation.

Define the adopted file-based mapping: only .md prose/instructions/skills/commands use link and identity checks; executable tooling/examples, tests, runtime/CLI implementation and schemas require the full gate; mixed or uncertain changes use stronger applicable checks.
